summary: Prairie Operating Co. filed an 8-K reporting a credit agreement amendment reaffirming a $475 million borrowing base, modifying distributable free cash flow covenants, and increasing redetermination cadence. It also entered a letter agreement with High Trail regarding conversion of remaining Series F Convertible Preferred Stock into common stock. No pricing, premium, or deal terms were disclosed. The filing is a routine debt modification and conversion arrangement, not a special situation. Watch for future disclosures on preferred stock conversion mechanics.
